notes.title: 1.4 Patch Now Live! 📢
notes.notes:
Hey Pals! 👋

Our 1.4 patch is now live! 😱

This patch includes: 
- Colourblind mode
- General bug fixes
- Visual Polish
- Performance improvements

Not only that, but if you own a Nintendo Switch™ Putty Pals is currently 40% off on the eShop! 🛒 The sale ends on the 09/08 CEST so don’t miss out! 📅⏳

As always, feel free to let us know if you come across any issues! 

Thanks for playing 🤗

Your Pals,
HG 😊

notes.title: Putty Pals 1.3 Update + Nintendo Switch Release Date
notes.notes:
We have an exciting announcement Pals! 📢

Putty Pals will be releasing on the Nintendo Switch™ on the 18th (US) & 19th (AUS/EU) of October! 😱

And for our beloved Steam players…. Don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about you! 🤗 

We will be releasing our 1.3 update which will include:

World 3: The Puttazon jungle! 🌴
6 beach & 4 Jungle levels
9 bonus mini-levels
2 adorable new Putty (Pink & Purple)
A new soundtrack for the new world 🎵

As well as!

Added Italian and Spanish languages 🗺
Environmental art additions 🎨
Better optimisation 🚀
New achievements 🏆


So grab your pal 🤝 It’s time to team up to tackle another adventure! 🚩

Your pals,
HG 😄 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27757755/52d6f9863a10c35c845f90cf3eff97a2564b6821.png

notes.title: 1.1 Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Putty Pals 1.1 UPDATE IS NOW LIVE!!!


Our first big update for Putty Pals is now live pals!


What does the update include???


Time Trial Mode
MacOS Support
Steam Achievements
Steam Trading Cards
Support for Japanese and German Languages
Stability and Performance Improvements


We hope you enjoy our new update and we look forward to bringing you more content in the future!

Have fun folks!!

Your Pals,
HG :D

notes.title: Post Launch Update!
notes.notes:
Successful Launch!	

Putty Pals’ launch on Steam has been received with positive gusto!

We are so grateful to you all for having bought, played, and positively reviewed the game in our first week.

It has been amazing to see the game played by our Putty Pals around the world, and we look forward to reaching more and more people in the future!
 
 Review & Share With Friends!	

If you loved your experience playing Putty Pals please Review it on our Steam Store page and help our ratings soar so we can make new Pals. Share with friends and family and let’s build this brand new Putty network!

Share your Putt-erific moments with us on Facebook and Twitter (#PuttyPals)! We’d love to see your crazy teamwork acrobatic skillz.
 
 Exciting Updates Coming Soon…	

We have exciting stuff coming very soon and we can’t wait to share the news with you all! Keep your eyes peeled and watch this Putty space…
 
Your Pals,
HG
